scene_context.physical_setting: Indoor domestic dining area; wooden table, chandelier visible
scene_context.social_context: Group social gathering involving a card game (likely 'Indian Poker' or similar)
scene_context.emotional_atmosphere: Initially casual/playful, shifting to high-intensity sentimental/celebratory

characters.physical_description: Adult female, blonde hair in bun, wearing grey athletic long-sleeve top
characters.role_in_scene: Target of surprise proposal / Game participant

initial_state.body_language_summary: Seated, holding card to forehead, scanning other players' faces
initial_state.apparent_goal: To play the card game correctly
behavioral_evidence: Micro-expressions of confusion regarding game rules

final_state.body_language_summary: Standing, embracing male partner, crying, burying face in his shoulder

behavioral_evidence: Transition from static sitting to rapid hand movements covering face

characters.physical_description: Adult male, dark hair, black t-shirt, tattoos on arms

initial_state.body_language_summary: Standing/leaning, active gesturing, controlling the flow of the game
initial_state.apparent_goal: To set up the surprise proposal
behavioral_evidence: Standing while others sit (dominance/control of scene)

final_state.apparent_goal: To comfort and celebrate with partner
behavioral_evidence: Relaxed shoulder tension compared to start
Visible relaxation after she nods/says yes

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Subject holds card to head -> Scans others for clues -> Indicates adherence to game rules -> Motivation is social compliance and play.

supporting_evidence.description: Adjusting card on forehead and looking at neighbor's card

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Male interrupts game ('Time out') -> Subject freezes and looks around -> Facial expression shows confusion (brow furrow) -> Desire shifts to understanding the disruption.

supporting_evidence.description: Furrowed brow, mouth slightly open, scanning environment for explanation

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Subject recognizes proposal context -> Emotional explosion (tears, hands to face) -> Nods head -> Extends hand for ring -> Hugs partner. This sequence confirms desire to accept the social contract of marriage.

supporting_evidence.description: Extending left hand to facilitate ring placement

alternative_interpretations.reasoning: Her behavior (covering face, crying) is largely reactive/regulatory, but the nodding and hand extension prove the underlying social desire.
alternative_interpretations.why_not_primary: Regulation is the mechanism, bonding is the goal.

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Subject controls game flow -> Calls 'Time out' -> Positions self strategically -> Intent is to create a specific social moment (proposal) via deception/surprise.

supporting_evidence.description: Gesturing for 'time out' and moving to kneeling position

trigger_event.description: Male partner kneels down and produces a ring box

behavioral_markers.description: Transition from confusion to shock (mouth drops open)

desire_transitions.visual_marker_of_change: The exact moment at 00:16 when her mouth opens in an 'O' shape and she recoils slightly, realizing the game has ended and a proposal has begun.
desire_transitions.psychological_interpretation: A rapid re-orientation of Beliefs (Game -> Proposal) triggers a massive emotional response and a shift in Desire from game-compliance to life-partner-acceptance.

behavioral_sequence.behavior_description: Gasping, hands covering mouth, widening eyes
behavioral_sequence.relevance_to_desire: Indicates the 'Game Participation' desire has been interrupted by a high-salience event.

behavioral_sequence.behavior_description: Extending left hand while nodding vigorously

key_segments_for_qa.segment_description: The moment the proposal is revealed.
key_segments_for_qa.psychological_significance: Excellent example of 'Belief' violation leading to 'Desire' transformation. The subject realizes her belief (playing a game) was false.

inter_character_dynamics.mutual_influence: The male's action (kneeling) completely dictates the female's emotional and motivational state shift.

key_interaction_moments.description: Male kneels, changing the power dynamic and context.
Mutual embrace, synchronizing their emotional states.

annotation_metadata.annotation_notes: The scene contains other individuals (older male holding baby, other women), but their desires are secondary/spectator-based (Social_Event_Witnessing). Annotation focused on the primary dyad.
